research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Advano is engaged in developing silicon-based materials for lithium-ion batteries, as shown by work on silicon anode compositions formed by dispersing silicon in specific solvents and milling, described in 'Silicon anode and batteries made therefrom.' Research also covers nanosized silicon particulates produced via milling in polar solvents, as detailed in 'Nano silicon particulates, method to make them and articles made therefrom,' and porous silicon-carbon matrix composites for battery use, as in 'Silicon electrolyte composite particles, compositions and uses in lithium ion.'

overview_description.description: Advano is a New Orleans-based company delivering a scalable solution for lithium-ion batteries with higher energy density. By conquering the challenges of silicon, Advano integrates or completely replaces graphite in today’s lithium-ion batteries with its advanced silicon anode material - improving the longevity of lithium-ion batteries for battery manufacturers and Tier one consumer electronics and automotive companies.

about_short_description.short_description: Advano is a renewable energy power company delivering a scalable silicon solution for lithium-ion batteries.

product.name: REALSi Material
product.description: A customizable platform material technology designed for enhancing lithium-ion batteries by addressing silicon side-effects through a porous, conductive architecture.

product.name: REALSi
product.description: A silicon anode material technology designed to enhance lithium-ion battery performance by integrating silicon into existing battery designs, improving energy density and reducing costs.

product.name: Customizable Materials
product.description: Materials that can be tailored to meet specific battery requirements, allowing for innovation and enhancement in diverse battery ecosystems.

product.name: Patented Secondary Particle Design
product.description: A 3D secondary structure that mitigates mechanical stress and electrode degradation in silicon during charging cycles, maintaining structural integrity and conductivity.

product.name: Manufacturing Processes and Equipment
product.description: Utilizes existing, scalable manufacturing technologies and low-cost processing equipment for the production of silicon solutions for batteries.

product.name: Surface Functionalization
product.description: A platform that enables 3D architecting and surface protection of materials, ensuring compatibility with polymer and solid electrolytes.
